text.name: TextDesc2
text.text: BennuGD is an open-source game development framework designed for creating 2D games and interactive applications. It evolved from the Fenix programming language and provides a simple scripting environment focused on graphics, sound, input, and multimedia features. The engine has been used for independent games, remakes, and homebrew projects across multiple platforms. BennuGD continues the tradition of accessible game development tools that allow creators to build games without requiring complex commercial engines.
